nameEn: Manufacture of other fabricated metal products n.e.c.
description: This class includes the manufacture of a variety of fabricated metal products not elsewhere classified.
includes: manufacture of metal cable, braided wire and similar articles
manufacture of coated or cored wire for welding and similar purposes
manufacture of nails, tacks, staples (excluding staples for offices), bolts, nuts, screws, rivets and similar fasteners
manufacture of springs (except watch springs): leaf springs, coil springs, helical springs, torsion bar springs
manufacture of chain (except power transmission chain)
manufacture of cans and containers of metal (except tanks and reservoirs)
manufacture of household articles of metal: pots, pans, trays, tins, jacks, weights
manufacture of metal boxes, crates, drums, canisters
manufacture of metal crowns and closures
manufacture of metal anchors, grappling irons, ships' propellers
manufacture of metal signs (non-electric), number plates
excludes: manufacture of tanks and reservoirs, see 2512
manufacture of weapons and ammunition, see 2520
forging, pressing, stamping and roll-forming of metal, see 2591
manufacture of cutlery and hand tools, see 2593
